_comment: Copy this file to paths.local.json (gitignored) and fill in the paths for this machine. Keys are looked up by config.py's local() / config.R's path_local(); a missing key or missing file just means the caller falls back to its own default or errors asking you to set it.
_python_comment: Used by tools/*.sh (launch_job, finish_experiment). Optional: falls back to <conda base>/envs/buzzdetect-train.

audio_sources._comment: Raw source-audio directories that live outside this repo, keyed by the 01_annotate effort directory name that needs them.

_distill_cache_comment: 05_distill: teacher-target cache (mel, code, logits per slice); big, on the audio drive.
